annotations.title: WhatsApp account: notices, costs, catalog, ad conversions

description: One WhatsApp Business Account. "notices": Meta's notices for it, newest first (template reviews, restrictions and disconnects, number quality and messaging-limit changes, display-name and username reviews, account alerts). "pricing": what its messages cost, read from Meta (start, end, granularity DAILY | HALF_HOUR | MONTHLY, dimensions COUNTRY | PHONE | PRICING_CATEGORY | PRICING_TYPE | TIER, countries, pricingCategories, pricingTypes, phoneNumberId); volume always, cost where Meta shows it. "catalogs", "link_catalog" / "unlink_catalog" (catalogId from list_meta_catalogs, confirm:true): the product catalog WhatsApp shows. "dataset" / "provision_dataset" (confirm:true): the Click-to-WhatsApp conversions dataset. "send_conversion" (to = the customer, eventName LeadSubmitted | QualifiedLead | Purchase | AddToCart | InitiateCheckout | ViewContent | OrderCreated | OrderCanceled | OrderReturned, eventId, value, currency): reports a sale or lead from a chat: attributed to the WhatsApp ad click when the chat began with one in the last 7 days, otherwise matched on the customer's hashed phone number plus the Page (pageId, needed when the brand has several Pages); testCode (from Events Manager > the dataset > Test events) sends it as a test event that shows there and counts nowhere. "conversions" lists what was sent. Creating the dataset and sending events need the Meta connection's WhatsApp conversions add-on (Connectors > WhatsApp > Enable WhatsApp conversions); without it the refusal carries the link. "move_to_brand" (toBrand, confirm:true, account owner only): make another of your brands use this account. 0 credits.

eventId.description: your own id for this event, so a repeat is not counted twice

pageId.description: send_conversion with no ad click on record: the Facebook Page the WhatsApp ads run from (list_meta_pages)

start.description: pricing: a date or date-time (default 30 days ago)

testCode.description: send_conversion: Events Manager test code; the event is a test that counts nowhere

to.description: send_conversion: the customer's phone or business-scoped id

toBrand.description: move_to_brand: the brand id or name (list_brands)

wabaId.description: optional when exactly one account is shared with this profile
